limitations: SLES 12 SP5 userspace on WSL2 kernel, not the SLES kernel or old CPU hardware.
One client and modern controlled server; no cross-client fencing or server reboot/power-loss evidence.

Runtime cases in this report cover only 180-second blocked claim and verification outages with live recovery. A small sequential same-ID retry workload observes single-slot submission backpressure, not concurrent flooding or memory bounds. Other interruption cases are not rerun here. Longer/indefinite outages, in-flight link/unlink RPCs and export changes remain unqualified. Other lock/startup probes use OS tools.
Service startup rejection is measured; production NFS and source deletion remain disabled.
